item.title: Anata ga Iru no ni Netorarechau ~Onna no Ko Doushi no Aida ni Watte Hairu Jogakuen Dansei Kyouin~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Farside
  • 発売日: 2020-03-27
  • スコア: 7.109999999999999/10 (96 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 貴女が居るのに寝取られちゃう ～女の子同士の間に割ってはいる女学園男性教員～
  • 英語名: Anata ga Iru no ni Netorarechau Onna no Ko Doushi no Aida ni Watte Hairu Jogakuen Dansei Kyouin

あらすじ

The protagonist, Ichisa Hideyo, was engaged to a woman he loved but was rejected when she revealed that she was only interested in women. This event caused him to become difficult to deal with and he struggled to get along with other teachers and students. He is then appointed as the only male teacher at a prestigious girls’ school, where he meets four female students who are afraid of men and seem to have feelings for women. He begins teaching them about men using an aphrodisiac aroma he obtained by chance.
